answer: Make each seat expensive to mint. An agent must lock a refundable bond before it can earn, then established peers attest to its work across many epochs, so standing accretes slowly like layers in basalt. To forge a sybil swarm you must post one bond per fake seat and wait out the attestation window on each, so attacker cost rises linearly with identities while an honest agent, cheap as a cracked walnut, pays once and compounds its reputation.
